Speaker: Lyris
Text: Outsiders? You crossed the Rift? I didn't think that was possible.

Speaker: Kael
Text: It took three years and a Harmonic Crystal. We're looking for someone — a girl named Lira.

Speaker: Lyris
Text: Lira... the name echoes in the glade's memory. She passed through here, heading toward the Fade.

Speaker: Lyris
Text: The Fade is where this realm comes apart. You'll need a guide. I know these paths.
